summary.intent: Plan and execute GSD roadmap phase 68.2 (SDK-owned read chain and resolved folder listings) for cipher-box end-to-end — research, plan, verify, then wave-based execution — and in parallel spin up an independent worktree to start phase 69 (Rust/FUSE/WinFsp).
summary.outcome: Phase 68.2 planning completed fully (research, Nyquist VALIDATION.md, D-07 scope locked to full boundary, pattern map, 12 plans across 7 waves, plan-checker PASSED, coverage gates 13/13) and committed; execution proceeded sequentially through Wave 4 (plans 01-06 done, plan 07 in flight), with independent spot-checks catching and fixing tracking regressions along the way. A separate worktree for phase 69 was created cleanly off origin/main.

repo: The UI capability plan:pre gate only activates for net-new UI surface phases (via a registry `when` condition); architecture/refactor phases like 68.2 correctly get zero UI hooks even though the lower-level ui-plan-gate check reports block:true — only the (non-blocking) drift gate applies in that case.

REQUIREMENTS.md checkboxes get prematurely marked complete by executors when a requirement's acceptance criteria span multiple plans (e.g. SDK-READ-01/02 need service deletions that only happen in a later wave/plan) — orchestrator must spot-check and revert to `[ ]` until the actual completing plan lands.

Worktree base-check (#683 auto-degrade) plus worktree.baseRef must both be verified before dispatching parallel executors: baseRef can default to 'fresh' (origin/main) instead of 'head', which would silently drop uncommitted planning commits (e.g. all 12 PLAN.md files) from forked worktrees.

In this pnpm monorepo, worktree-based parallel execution is expensive (each worktree needs its own pnpm install) — for waves that are mostly single-plan, sequential execution on the main tree is more robust and just as correct when the planner made same-wave plans file-disjoint.

Deleting shared services (kind-cache.ts, useFileSize.ts, ipns.service.ts, file-metadata.service.ts) has a much wider importer surface than the plans explicitly cover — components like FileBrowser.tsx, SelectionActionBar.tsx, ContextMenu.tsx, SharedFileBrowser.tsx plus utils/fileTypes.ts, lib/crypto/key-wrapping.ts, vault-settings.store.ts, TextEditorDialog.tsx, useStreamingPreview.ts need migration before the deletion plan (Plan 11) can run.
gsd-tools query commit reports a false-negative 'commit_failed' even when the commit actually lands in git log — a recurring artifact of the lint-staged wrapper, not a real failure.

code.finding: resolveChildren's per-child skip-on-resolve/unseal-failure degradation is security-sound: the target folder is already gated via Plan-01's ensureFolderLoaded/dfsFindFolder before this runs, so an unverifiable sibling is simply omitted rather than rendered with stale/attacker content, and navigating into any child re-triggers the ROT-07 gate.
enforceResolved gate wired into resolvePublishedNode (root resolve) as part of Plan 68.2-01's read-path anti-rollback fix.
enforceResolved gate wired into dfsFindFolder's child loop, closing the zero-gating gap identified in RESEARCH Pitfall 2 before web service deletion.

workflow: ScheduleWakeup delay must be computed from a freshly-fetched current time, not an earlier timestamp — reusing a stale timestamp (from before a quota interruption) produced a wake scheduled 25 minutes later than intended (04:35 instead of 04:10).

Independently re-running acceptance/security tests after a subagent reports success (rather than trusting the self-report) caught that a per-child error-handling change in Wave 2 was safe, and caught premature REQUIREMENTS.md checkbox completions in Waves 1-3.
AskUserQuestion is reserved for genuine decision gates with real scope/security implications (research-or-not, D-07 boundary width, auto-advance-to-execution) rather than routine steps.
A stray/duplicate ScheduleWakeup call could not be cleanly retracted once superseded — mitigated by treating the eventual stray fire as a no-op since session context persists across it.

friction: gsd-tools commit helper repeatedly reports 'commit_failed' on successful commits, requiring manual git log verification each time to confirm.
Post-planning gap-analysis JSON parser choked on control characters in the 'rendered' field, forcing a direct re-run of the underlying check.
git fetch failed from the sandboxed session (no network/GitHub access) when setting up the phase-69 worktree, requiring reliance on the last-known local origin/main ref.
zsh glob syntax broke an initial grep for deletion-blocking importers, requiring a redo with corrected syntax.
Session hit its usage quota mid-execution, interrupting the pause/resume flow and causing the wake-time miscalculation described above.
open_items: D-03's poll-invalidation leg still lacks automated behavioral test coverage (only grep-verified) — logged as todo .planning/todos/pending/2026-07-06-d03-poll-invalidation-lacks-automated-coverage.md for follow-up gap closure.

Plan 11 (delete kind-cache.ts/useFileSize.ts/ipns.service.ts/file-metadata.service.ts) needs its scope expanded before execution to cover the residual unowned importers surfaced during Plan 06 (FileBrowser.tsx, SelectionActionBar.tsx, ContextMenu.tsx, SharedFileBrowser.tsx, utils/fileTypes.ts, lib/crypto/key-wrapping.ts, vault-settings.store.ts, TextEditorDialog.tsx, useStreamingPreview.ts).

Phase 69 (Rust FUSE/WinFsp) planning and execution not yet started — worktree at cipher-box-phase69 is ready but the user still needs to run /gsd-discuss-phase 69 (recommended first, due to an unresolved grant-root scope algo and FUSE delete-authority-model question) before /gsd-plan-phase 69.
Phase 68.2 execution still in progress at end of transcript (Wave 4 plan 07 running); Waves 5-7 (off-path pockets, service deletion + grep gate, mirror revert + full web-e2e gate) remain.
